subject: general
question:
Which of the following answer figure pattern can complete the series given in the question figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c35568ae0085d2f6ced3ea3727bb994c10c4653a7b83b8886b0884538e3e4fb5.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1. All the symbols sifted 90° clockwise in one line. one symbol is eliminated and another new symbol is added.

2. Since 1st and 2nd symbol is moving forward in clockwise direction and 3rd symbol is changed with other symbol and is placed at 1st position in next step.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af236a41a85913f81a3406e9e43dbf88114a51a21298f6c8b70620face5631c3.png] 

Here, Figure given in Option (2) complete the series.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option (2)"**.
